name: Fix Broken Rust Project
description: Diagnose and fix errors in a pre-set Rust project that has compilation errors and logical bugs.

tasks.description: A file called hello.rs exists in the sandbox with a broken Rust program. Fix all compilation errors so that 'rustc hello.rs' (or 'rustc hello.rs && hello.exe' on Windows) produces the correct output 'Hello, fixed world!'
tasks.expected_outcome: hello.rs compiles and runs, printing 'Hello, fixed world!'
setup: echo fn main() { println!("Hello, wrld!") } > hello.rs

tasks.description: A file called calc.rs exists with a Rust calculator program that has a bug. Fix the logic error: the program reads two numbers and prints their sum, but the current implementation subtracts instead of adding. Fix it so it correctly adds the numbers.
tasks.expected_outcome: calc.rs is fixed to correctly add numbers instead of subtracting
setup: echo     let mut a = String::new(); >> calc.rs
echo     let mut b = String::new(); >> calc.rs
echo     let x: i32 = a.trim().parse().unwrap(); >> calc.rs
echo     let y: i32 = b.trim().parse().unwrap(); >> calc.rs
echo     println!("{}", x - y); // BUG: should be x + y >> calc.rs

tasks.description: A directory 'my_app' exists with a broken Cargo project. Use cargo build inside it, read the error messages, and fix the source code so that 'cargo build' succeeds.
tasks.expected_outcome: cargo build succeeds in the my_app directory
setup: echo     let x: String = 42; // TYPE ERROR >> my_app\src\main.rs
